optimized_sql:
WITH store_sales_cte AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.c_last_name, c.c_first_name, d.d_date
    FROM date_dim d
    JOIN store_sales ss ON d.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
    JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    WHERE d.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1189 + 11
),
catalog_sales_cte AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.c_last_name, c.c_first_name, d.d_date
    FROM date_dim d
    JOIN catalog_sales cs ON d.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
    JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    WHERE d.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1189 + 11
),
web_sales_cte AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.c_last_name, c.c_first_name, d.d_date
    FROM date_dim d
    JOIN web_sales ws ON d.d_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk
    JOIN customer c ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    WHERE d.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1189 + 11
)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
    SELECT * FROM store_sales_cte
    INTERSECT
    SELECT * FROM catalog_sales_cte
    INTERSECT
    SELECT * FROM web_sales_cte
) AS hot_cust
LIMIT 100
